note: Experiment thresholds, not safety limits. Slip is read over a trailing window of slipWindowTicks (0.5 s) because MuJoCo friction is soft: a cup creeps about 1 mm per window, and some 40 mm over a 110 s mission, far inside the friction cone, while a sliding cup moves centimetres per window. A windowed slip above slipWarnM is reported, above slipFailM fails the variant; the cumulative drift is reported beside it and judged by nothing. The oracle tolerances say how close to the Coulomb crossing an onset must be: MuJoCo friction is soft, so a cup begins to creep before the hard bound mu*g (windows of 8 mm were measured at 0.77 of it) and never after; the tolerance below the bound is therefore 0.5 m/s2 and the one above 0.3. Nothing is claimed inside the band. Each cup is judged at the point of the tray under it, episode by episode (episodes closer than episodeGapTicks are one): a slip must fall in an episode of its own cup, and an episode above the bound must hold a slip.
